::: {.content-visible when-format="pdf"}
```{=latex}
\newgeometry{margin=0pt}
\begin{titlepage}
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\paperwidth,height=\paperheight]{images/cover.png}
\end{titlepage}
\restoregeometry
\pagenumbering{arabic}
\setcounter{page}{1}
\tableofcontents
```
